snip.t: Other agents include parainfluenza,adenovirus,mycoplasma and other viruses like human metapneumovirus
Most cases of bronchiolitis result from a viral pathogen, such as RSV, rhinovirus, human metapneumovirus (hMPV), parainfluenza virus, adenovirus, coronavirus, influenza virus or human bocavirus.
Human metapneumovirus, has been increasingly implicated as an etiologic agent in bronchiolitis.
Most common causes include influenza A and B, RSV, human metapneumovirus, adenovirus, rhinovirus, rubeola, and varicella.
